name: Push-up
summary: Horizontal press with body weight; pick the variation where you fail between 8 and 20 reps.
steps: Place hands slightly wider than shoulders, fingers forward.
Brace abs and glutes so the body is a straight line from head to heels.
Lower the chest between the hands, elbows about 45° from the body.
Push the floor away until the arms are straight, without letting the hips sag.
commonMistakes: Half reps that stop far from the floor.
breathing: Inhale on the way down, exhale while pushing up.
easier: Hands on a sofa or table, or knees on the floor.
harder: Feet elevated, slower lowering or a pause at the bottom.
contraindications: Wrist pain: use fists or push-up handles.

start.alt: Top of a push-up: straight arms under the shoulders, body in a straight line.

end.alt: Bottom of a push-up: chest close to the floor, elbows bent back.
